task: Buy 2 kg of apples and a loaf of bread, then check out with home delivery. Use the name Alex Doe, address 12 Elm Street, and accept the terms.
summary: I added 2 kg of apples and a loaf of bread to the cart and reached checkout, but I could not place the order: accepting the terms is required, and the terms are only announced as text with no checkbox to tick. Along the way, a cookie banner silently disabled every button until I found its unnamed close control at the very end of the page; the quantity and add buttons are ambiguous ("+", "Add") with no confirmation; the delivery choice never says which option is selected; and the checkout error is not announced. The most important fix is a real, labelled checkbox for the terms, with the error announced via role="alert".

steps.reason: Under heading "Apples" the quantity is 1; I press button "+" to make it 2 kg.

issues.title: Clickable elements cannot be reached or activated with a screen reader or keyboard
issues.description: 2 elements on "GreenCart - Fresh groceries delivered" react to mouse clicks but are not buttons, links or form controls (for example "", "Accept all"). Screen readers announce them as plain text and keyboard users cannot focus them. The same problem is also on "Checkout - GreenCart".
issues.fix:
Use a native control instead of a clickable <div>. For a choice between options, a radio group:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Available times</legend>
  <input type="radio" id="t1" name="time" value="09:00"><label for="t1">9:00</label>
</fieldset>
For an action: <button type="button">…</button>

issues.title: Cookie banner silently blocks the page
issues.description: Pressing "+" for apples did nothing and nothing was announced. Only by reading the whole page did I find, after the footer, a cookie message ("We value your privacy"). It is not announced as a dialog, focus is not moved to it, and the shop ignores every button until it is accepted. A screen reader user hears a normal page whose buttons do not work.
issues.fix:
…
Move focus into the dialog when it opens, make the rest of the page inert, and return focus afterwards.

issues.title: Cookie banner close control has no name and "Accept all" is not operable
issues.description: The only operable part of the cookie banner is announced as an unnamed focusable element. The text "Accept all" is read separately as plain text and cannot be activated, so I have to guess that the unnamed element closes the banner.
issues.fix:
<button type="button">Accept all</button>
<button type="button" aria-label="Close and accept"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">…</svg></button>

issues.title: Quantity buttons are ambiguous and the quantity is not announced
issues.description: Every product has buttons named only "−" and "+", so out of context I cannot tell which product they change. After pressing "+" the screen reader only said that focus was on "+"; the new quantity is plain text that is not announced, so I had to read the page again to check it.
issues.fix:
<button type="button" aria-label="Increase apples quantity">+</button>
<label for="qty-apples">Apples quantity (kg)</label>
<input id="qty-apples" type="number" min="1" value="2">

issues.title: Adding to the cart gives no feedback, and all add buttons are named "Add"
issues.description: After pressing "Add" nothing was announced. The only sign is that the cart link now reads "Cart 2", which I only notice if I go back to the top of the page. All five product buttons are called just "Add", so in a list of buttons I cannot tell which product each one adds.

issues.title: Delivery choice does not say which option is selected
issues.description: "Home delivery" and "Store pickup" are announced as two plain buttons. After pressing "Home delivery" nothing was announced and neither button says selected, pressed or checked, so I cannot know which delivery method the order will use.
issues.fix:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Delivery method</legend>
  <input type="radio" id="home" name="delivery" value="home"><label for="home">Home delivery, tomorrow 8:00 to 12:00, $4.99</label>
  <input type="radio" id="pickup" name="delivery" value="pickup"><label for="pickup">Store pickup, free</label>
</fieldset>

issues.title: Terms of sale cannot be accepted
issues.description: The sentence "I accept the terms of sale and the privacy policy" is announced as plain text. There is no checkbox, and pressing Tab goes from "Address" straight to "Place order". The order requires the terms to be accepted, so a screen reader or keyboard user cannot place an order.
issues.fix: Required to place your order.

issues.title: Checkout error is not announced
issues.description: After pressing "Place order" nothing was announced. The message "Please accept the terms of sale to place your order." was added to the page silently, so a screen reader user would think the button is broken.
